confidence_notes: Recent city price indexes give a useful basis for meals, coffee and beer. Cocktail and wine estimates use their reported local price relationship to beer because separate city data are sparse. Accommodation is a broad model estimate, not based on live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Vang Vieng city-price benchmarks; accommodation estimates reflect budget lodging in Laos backpacker towns, adjusted for Vang Vieng's smaller market.
